"Is it bigger than a breadbox?" looks like the best fit. Items that would be bigger: airplane, bed, bicycle, boat, bridge, car, chair, helicopter, house, lighthouse, piano, refrigerator, rocket, skateboard, table, television, tent, train, window, ladder, drum, guitar, and probably the mirror. That is roughly 23 of 53, which is close to even.

"Can you hold it in one hand?" would split about the same way.
